meta.title: BS EN 1990 to BS EN 1999 Eurocode series
meta.description: Real series metadata for the British adoption of Eurocodes 0 to 9, compiled from public BSI catalogue pages. Relationship links are limited to public catalogue evidence plus clearly marked architecture-level inferences where full internal reference clauses are not openly published.
meta.referenceLimitations: Public BSI catalogue pages do not expose the full clause-by-clause normative and informative references inside each standard. The references in this file are graph-ready relationship links based on public series scope, representative current documents, and explicitly marked architecture inference.
